title: Removing Sand from the Putting Green
question: Your ball is just off the putting green. You decide to putt, but there is a patch of loose sand on the putting green directly on your line of play. Can you brush the sand away before making your stroke?

choices.text: No. Your ball is not on the putting green.
No. Sand may never be removed from your line of play.
Yes. Sand may be removed from the putting green, even if your ball is off the green.
Yes, but only if another player agrees.

explanation: Rule 13.1c allows players to remove sand and loose soil from the putting green, regardless of whether their ball is on or off the putting green.
